title: Cobblestone paving from Voronoi cells
purpose: Generate tileable PBR maps of cobblestone or sett paving: domed, worn stones from Voronoi cells with soil, sand or moss in the joints. Use for streets, courtyards, castle floors and garden paths.

contract.signature: generate(width=256, height=256, seed=0, preset="default", directx_normal=False, **parameters) -> {map name: {"channels", "colour_space", "pixels"}}
contract.command_line: python cobblestone_voronoi.py --size 1024 --seed 7 --preset NAME --out DIR [--width W --height H] [--set NAME=VALUE] [--directx-normal] [--orm]

parameters.name: stones_across
parameters.meaning: Stones across the tile (cells of the Voronoi grid per side).

parameters.name: jitter
parameters.meaning: How far each stone's centre strays from a square grid: 0 square setts, 1 irregular cobbles.

parameters.name: gap_width
parameters.meaning: Joint width between stones, in stone widths.

parameters.name: roundness
parameters.meaning: How far in from the edge the dome rises, in stone widths: small values give flat tops.

parameters.name: corner_rounding
parameters.meaning: Rounds the stone corners: 0 keeps the Voronoi polygon, 1 trims each stone to a disc.

parameters.name: irregularity
parameters.meaning: Noise on the stone outlines, in stone widths.

parameters.name: wear
parameters.meaning: Polish of the stone tops from foot traffic (lower roughness on the crowns).

parameters.name: gap_fill
parameters.meaning: Height of the soil or sand in the joints relative to the stone crowns.

parameters.name: moss
parameters.meaning: Moss growing in the joints and creeping onto stone edges.

parameters.name: colour_variation
parameters.meaning: Spread of colour and brightness between stones.

parameters.name: hue_shift
parameters.meaning: Hue rotation of the albedo in turns.

presets.name: default
presets.description: Grey granite cobbles with dark soil joints.

presets.name: river_rounded
presets.description: Rounded river stones in warm sand, deep joints.

presets.name: mossy
presets.description: Old irregular cobbles with moss in the joints.

presets.name: basalt_setts
presets.description: Dark basalt setts in a near-square grid with flat tops.

presets.name: sandstone
presets.description: Warm sandstone cobbles with pale mortar-like sand.

limits: Stones are Voronoi cells, optionally trimmed toward discs, so they read as cut setts or rounded cobbles rather than scanned stones. Stones do not overlap and have no undercut. With jitter near 1 a few feature points fall close together and give narrow stones. Moss and soil are noise masks. Occlusion is a blurred-height estimate.
technique_references: Worley (cellular) noise on a torus with jittered feature points
Distance to the Voronoi cell border from bisectors
Disc trimming by distance to the feature point
Fractional Brownian motion for outline and surface noise
Height to tangent-space normal by central differences
